class Base {

  int raw = 0;

  set doubled(int x) {
    raw = x * 2;
  }

}
class Box extends Base {

  int _v = 0;

  int viaUnqualified(int n) {
    value = n;
    return this.value;
  }

  int run(String mode, int n) {
    if (mode == 'pair') {
        this.value = n;
        return this.value;
    }

    if (mode == 'compound') {
        _v = 10;
        this.value += n;
        return this.value;
    }

    if (mode == 'nullaware') {
        _v = 0;
        this.value ??= n;
        return this.value;
    }

    if (mode == 'arrow') {
        scaled = n;
        return _v;
    }

    if (mode == 'inherited') {
        doubled = n;
        return raw;
    }

    if (mode == 'unqualified') {
        return viaUnqualified(n);
    }

    if (mode == 'this') {
        this.value = n;
        return _v;
    }

    return -1;
  }

  int get value {
    return _v;
  }

  set value(int x) {
    _v = x + 1;
  }

  set scaled(dynamic v) => _v = v * 10;

}
<<<< CODE_UNIT_END="/test" >>>>
